features.name: Compact efficient machine-pistol design; source grants one point recoil compensation without specifying a separate external device
Own FN5-7C art: angular upper, raked grip and rounded trigger opening; preserve proportions

Assigned sole final reference reviewer compared the own labeled FN5-7C art Arsenal printed22/PDF24, the actual raw pair, native independent masks, final2048 detail/clay teal views and paired overlay. Correct compact angular upper, short left front, raked grip, frame/upper steps, sights, trigger and BOTH intentional trigger clearances retained. No optional stock, foregrip, long magazine, optic, suppressor or compensator. Fine four front vents, slide serrations, screw-face recesses, grip diamonds/stippling and small control surface ridges are filled in clay. The separate raised top rail with its structural spacing, broad raised rear control bar and major upper/frame part boundaries remain geometry; they are not fine cosmetic surface cuts. Whole object and clear margins, no broad halo, no subject-part loss. Native1254square RGB originals were opaque; independently extracted alpha and common uniform2048 resampling preserve framing without warp. Four discarded tiny1–3px detailed-mask labels were guard-edge AA fringe, not subject parts. No manual retouch candidate is selected; both original generated references remain the selected pair. Reference-only visual approval; full maintained finish gates required.
